title: Wise Words
subtitle: WITH MARCO REYES  ·  STORY NIGHT

segments.head: TONIGHT: KAI'S BIG TALK
segments.author: Wise Words
lines: Good evening, everyone.
I'm Marco Reyes, and this is Wise Words.
Tonight's story is about Kai Kahale, a baggage handler at the Honolulu airport.
Every summer, Kai said he would paddle in the big Labor Day canoe race.
Every Labor Day, he watched it from the beach. With a plate lunch.

segments.head: CHAPTER 1: THE BIG TALK
segments.quote: Don't loaf and invite inspiration; light out after it with a club.
segments.author: Jack London
lines: At a family cookout, Kai said it again. This year, once I feel motivated.
His Auntie Lani, who had steered canoes for thirty years, handed him a paddle and quoted the writer Jack London:
Don't loaf and invite inspiration; light out after it with a club.
Practice is Tuesday, she said. Bring the club.

segments.head: CHAPTER 2: THE SNOOZE
segments.quote: Either you run the day or the day runs you.
segments.author: Jim Rohn
lines: Practice started at five thirty in the morning.
Kai hit snooze three times and watched the canoe leave without him.
On the clubhouse whiteboard was a line from Jim Rohn:
Either you run the day or the day runs you.
That night, he put his alarm across the room, next to the coffee maker.

segments.head: CHAPTER 3: THE DONUTS
segments.quote: No man is free who is not master of himself.
segments.author: Epictetus
lines: At work, the break room had a box of fresh malasadas.
Kai reached for his third. Then he remembered the magnet on Auntie's fridge, from the Greek thinker Epictetus:
No man is free who is not master of himself.
He put it back, and turned off the video games at ten.
His coworkers thought he was sick.

segments.head: CHAPTER 4: THE SPLASH
segments.quote: Unity is strength... when there is teamwork and collaboration, wonderful things can be achieved.
segments.author: Mattie Stepanek
lines: Now Kai was strong, and he wanted everyone to see it.
He paddled so hard the canoe zigzagged like a shopping cart.
Mrs. Kealoha, sixty-one, turned around. Stop paddling like you're alone. Mattie Stepanek said it best:
Unity is strength... when there is teamwork and collaboration, wonderful things can be achieved.
So Kai matched her beat. The canoe flew.

segments.head: CHAPTER 5: THE FLIP
segments.quote: The gods help them that help themselves.
segments.author: Aesop
lines: Race day. Halfway across the bay, a big wave flipped their canoe.
Six paddlers in the water. Kai looked around for the rescue boat.
Then he heard Auntie, quoting Aesop:
The gods help them that help themselves.
Kai yelled, one, two, three! They flipped it back, bailed it out and climbed in.

segments.head: CHAPTER 6: THE FINISH
segments.quote: Good friends, good books, and a sleepy conscience: this is the ideal life.
segments.author: Mark Twain
lines: They finished fourteenth out of twenty. Soaking wet and laughing.
On the beach, Auntie gave Kai a worn book with a line from Mark Twain inside the cover:
Good friends, good books, and a sleepy conscience: this is the ideal life.
That night, Kai was asleep by eight.
Next summer, he didn't talk about the race. He just showed up.

segments.head: THAT'S TONIGHT'S STORY
segments.quote: Go after it. Run your day. Master yourself. Paddle together. Help yourself. Rest easy.
segments.author: Marco Reyes
lines: That's tonight's story.
Go after it. Run your day. Master yourself. Paddle together. Help yourself. Then rest easy.
I tried a canoe once. The canoe won.
I'm Marco Reyes. Good night.
